stem.en: Separating the 1-D heat equation with u(0,t) = u(L,t) = 0 leads to X″ + λX = 0 with X(0) = X(L) = 0. Why does this only have a solution for specific positive values of λ, rather than for any λ?
stem.et: 1-D soojusvõrrandi eraldamine tingimustega u(0,t) = u(L,t) = 0 annab X″ + λX = 0 tingimustega X(0) = X(L) = 0. Miks on lahend olemas ainult kindlate positiivsete λ väärtuste jaoks, mitte iga λ jaoks?

label.en: Only certain λ (the eigenvalues) give a general solution of X″ + λX = 0 that can satisfy both X(0) = 0 and X(L) = 0 simultaneously without forcing X to be identically zero
label.et: Ainult teatud λ (omaväärtused) annavad X″ + λX = 0 üldlahendi, mis suudab rahuldada nii X(0) = 0 kui X(L) = 0 samaaegselt, sundimata X-i olema samaselt null

label.en: Any λ works algebraically; the restriction to specific values is just a simplifying convention, not a requirement
label.et: Iga λ toimib algebraliselt; piirdumine kindlate väärtustega on ainult lihtsustav kokkulepe, mitte nõue

label.en: Because a single separated product solution X(x)T(t) can only ever represent one special case, not a general solution to the heat equation
label.et: Kuna üks eraldatud korrutislahend X(x)T(t) saab esindada vaid üht erijuhtu, mitte soojusvõrrandi üldlahendit

label.en: Because the resulting eigenfunctions would otherwise fail to be orthogonal under a plain, unweighted integral
label.et: Kuna tekkivad omafunktsioonid ei oleks vastasel juhul ortogonaalsed tavalise, kaalumata integraali all
